widget.name: Onboarding Widget
widget.description: Guide users through your app with a step-by-step tour.

property.caption: Run trigger
property.description: Boolean attribute. When this value is true, the tour runs. If closed, it won't restart until the value is reset or the page reloads.

property.caption: Show progress
property.description: Choose how to display the progress indicator.

property.caption: On tour finish
property.description: Action to execute after the last step is completed.

property.caption: On tour exit
property.description: Action to execute when the user closes or skips the tour before finishing.

property.caption: Steps data source
property.description: Data source returning the list of tour step objects.

property.caption: Target selector
property.description: String attribute containing the CSS selector for the target element (e.g., .my-class or #my-id).

property.caption: Step content
property.description: Widgets to render inside the tooltip for each step.

property.caption: Primary color
property.description: Main color used for buttons and active elements.

property.caption: Background color
property.description: Background color of the tooltip card.

property.caption: Text color
property.description: Color of the text inside the tooltip.

property.caption: Border radius
property.description: Corner radius of the tooltip card (in pixels).

property.caption: Custom styles (JSON)
property.description: Optional JSON object to override react-joyride styles. See https://docs.react-joyride.com/styling for structure.

property.caption: Back button label
property.description: Text to display on the 'Back' button.

property.caption: Next button label
property.description: Text to display on the 'Next' button.

property.caption: Finish button label
property.description: Text to display on the 'Finish' button.
